step_up_not_confirmed: It wasn't confirmed: the window was closed or the passkey prompt timed out. Nothing was changed.
access_step_up_resumed: Confirmed. Enter the code again to approve.
wallet_import_description: Choose an export from your password manager, review the logins and save only those you select.
wallet_import_scope: Imports website addresses, usernames, passwords and names. Notes, cards, passkeys, one-time codes and extra fields stay in your password manager.
wallet_import_plaintext: Use a plaintext export and delete the file after importing. It is read only in this browser; selected passwords go straight to your engine.
wallet_import_formats: Bitwarden JSON or CSV; CSV from 1Password, LastPass, Chrome or Edge. Up to 5 MB and 1,000 logins.
wallet_import_invalid: This file is not a supported export. Choose a Bitwarden JSON or a CSV with website, username and password columns.
wallet_import_encrypted: This export is encrypted. Export a plaintext JSON or CSV file from your password manager.
wallet_import_too_large: Choose a file smaller than 5 MB.
wallet_import_too_many: Import at most 1,000 logins at a time.
wallet_import_read_failed: The file could not be read. Select it again.
wallet_import_existing_hint: Saved logins are not selected. Select one explicitly to replace its password. Duplicate site/account pairs inside the file are skipped.
wallet_import_skipped: Skipped {count} entries: duplicates, deleted or archived items, unsupported entries, or missing website, username or password.
wallet_import_empty: No supported website logins were found.
wallet_import_new_conflicts: Skipped {count} logins that were saved after the preview.
wallet_import_step_up: Confirm your identity to continue. If sign-in takes you away from this page, select the export again afterwards.
wallet_import_save_failed: The import stopped. Some logins may already be saved.
wallet_import_partial: The remaining logins were not imported. Saved logins stay in your Wallet. Select the export again to review what is left; after a connection failure, check the last attempted login too.
wallet_import_cancel_hint: Cancel stops further imports. Logins already sent to the engine stay saved.
browser_state_someone_controls: Agent paused, someone else is in control
browser_blocked_origin: The tab went to {site}, which this session can't show. Frames and your input stop until it's back.
browser_blocked_browser_page: The tab is on a page of the browser itself, which is never shown.
browser_blocked_secret_page: The tab shows a page with secrets, which is never shown.
browser_end_idle: The session ended after 2 minutes without input. The agent has the tab again.
browser_end_not_attached: The session ended before it connected.
browser_end_revoked: Your access to this session was revoked.
browser_end_protocol_error: The connection was closed after an error.
browser_hint_controlling: Your clicks and keys go to the site. Shift+Esc gives the keyboard back to this page.
browser_hint_watching: You're watching. Nothing you do here reaches the tab.
browser_trust: Nothing you type is kept. The agent learns only how your session ended, never what you did or typed.
browser_bar_signing_in: You're signing in {where} in the project's browser
browser_help_captcha: {agent} needs you to solve a check
browser_help_confirmation: {agent} needs you to confirm a step
browser_help_other: {agent} needs your help in the browser
browser_help_dismissed: Dismissed. The agent goes on without your help.
browser_sign_in_here: Sign in in the project's browser
browser_error_tab_full: Too many people are in this tab. Try again in a moment.
browser_error_tab_controlled: Someone else is controlling this tab.
browser_error_busy: Another sign-in tab is open in this project. End it first.
browser_error_origin_refused: The project doesn't allow signing in to this site from here.
browser_error_unavailable: The project's browser isn't available right now.
browser_not_found: This browser session isn't available. It may have ended, or it belongs to another sign-in.
